reasons.preference_fit: All attractions match user's preference for historical sites and natural landscapes. No early starts (all begin at 10:00) respects habit of not liking early mornings.
reasons.pacing: Each day has well-structured morning and afternoon sessions with reasonable 1.5-hour gaps between activities.
reasons.geographic_coherence: Activities are geographically grouped by day - Day 1 in urban Nanjing, Days 2-3 in Jiangning district, minimizing travel time.
reasons.time_realism: All activities start at reasonable times (10:00, 13:30) with appropriate durations. Good weather conditions support the schedule.
reasons.completeness: Missing transportation details between spots, meal arrangements, entrance fees, accommodation, and emergency information.
reasons.diversity_and_dining: Good variety of attraction types (historical, natural, theme park) but lacks specific dining and rest planning.

overall_comment: Well-structured itinerary that matches user preferences and has good geographic grouping, but lacks essential practical details for execution.
